snippet.title: Front-Trends
snippet.description: Front-Trends is a 3-day conference for web and mobile developers to discover the latest trends, technologies, and ideas in front-end development. For over 5 years, Front-Trends has brought together people from all over the world who are shaping the face of the internet and the future of human-technology interaction.
